description.id: Square drive sockets, adapter, extension bar, universal joint, dan attachment untuk fastening produksi, workshop, serta kebutuhan khusus.
description.en: Square drive sockets, adapters, extension bars, universal joints, and attachments for production fastening, workshop work, and special applications.

summary.id: Socket standard, deep, single hex, dan double hex dengan square drive dari 1/4 inci (6.35 mm) hingga 2-1/2 inci (63.5 mm).
summary.en: Standard, deep, single-hex, and double-hex sockets with square drives from 1/4 inch (6.35 mm) through 2-1/2 inches (63.5 mm).

summary.id: Komponen untuk konversi square drive, menambah jangkauan, dan mengakses fastener pada sudut atau area yang terbatas.
summary.en: Components for square-drive conversion, extended reach, and access to fasteners at an angle or in restricted spaces.

summary.id: Special parts dan custom-made tooling untuk bentuk fastener, proses assembly, atau akses kerja yang tidak dapat ditangani produk standar.
summary.en: Special parts and custom-made tooling for fastener profiles, assembly processes, or access conditions that standard products cannot address.

summary.id: Socket pengganti cepat untuk berpindah dari screw-fastening ke nut dan bolt fastening, tersedia dalam tipe single, double, magnetic, dan one-touch slide.
summary.en: Quick-change sockets for moving from screw-fastening to nut and bolt fastening, including single, double, magnetic, and one-touch slide types.

summary.id: Die holder, tap holder, socket adapter, tap holder bit, dan die bit untuk thread repair serta pekerjaan fastening khusus.
summary.en: Die holders, tap holders, socket adapters, tap-holder bits, and die bits for thread repair and specialized fastening work.

description.id: B-series driver sockets dan bits untuk electric tool, pneumatic tool, rechargeable drill, dan automatic assembly machine.
description.en: B-series driver sockets and bits for electric tools, pneumatic tools, rechargeable drills, and automatic assembly machines.

summary.id: Sistem shank H6.35 mm (1/4 inci) dengan driver socket single/double hex, hexagon bits, angle bits, dan pilihan B-35 serta B-38.
summary.en: H6.35 mm (1/4-inch) shank system with single/double-hex driver sockets, hexagon bits, angle bits, and B-35 or B-38 options.

summary.id: B-40 memakai shank H6.35 mm dan mencakup driver socket, double-ended driver bit, tapping-screw bit, countersunk-screw bit, serta hexagon bit.
summary.en: B-40 uses an H6.35 mm shank and covers driver sockets, double-ended driver bits, tapping-screw bits, countersunk-screw bits, and hexagon bits.

summary.id: Sistem shank H5 mm untuk driver socket single hex, hexagon driver bit, dan double-ended bit dalam beberapa panjang kerja.
summary.en: H5 mm shank system for single-hex driver sockets, hexagon driver bits, and double-ended bits in several working lengths.

summary.id: B-37 H6.35 mm untuk rechargeable drill dan driver, serta B-45 H8 mm untuk double-ended Phillips bits.
summary.en: B-37 H6.35 mm bits for rechargeable drills and drivers, plus B-45 H8 mm double-ended Phillips bits.

summary.id: Bits H4, H5, DB, dan threaded M5/M6 untuk automatic screw-fastening equipment serta robot assembly.
summary.en: H4, H5, DB, and threaded M5/M6 bits for automatic screw-fastening equipment and robotic assembly.

summary.id: Rangkaian 1/4, 3/8, dan 1/2 inci TORX socket, internal driver bit, tamper-resistant bit, external driver socket, dan magnetic screw holder.
summary.en: A range of 1/4, 3/8, and 1/2-inch TORX sockets, internal driver bits, tamper-resistant bits, external driver sockets, and magnetic screw holders.

summary.id: Detachable magnetic rings untuk screwdriver bits dan magnetizer BMD200 untuk membantu menahan screw pada ujung bit.
summary.en: Detachable magnetic rings for screwdriver bits and the BMD200 magnetizer to help retain screws at the bit tip.

description.id: Quick coupling NAC untuk udara, air, oli, vacuum, hydraulic pressure, mold cooling, dan koneksi khusus—dari low pressure hingga high pressure.
description.en: NAC quick couplings for air, water, oil, vacuum, hydraulic pressure, mold cooling, and special connections—from low through high pressure.

summary.id: Seri low-pressure single-valve paling populer untuk factory air piping dan air tools, dengan pilihan steel, brass, atau SUS304.
summary.en: NAC's most popular low-pressure, single-valve series for factory air piping and air tools, in steel, brass, or SUS304.

summary.id: Quick coupling low-pressure single-valve dengan bore lebih besar untuk aliran udara, air, atau oli pada koneksi 1/2 hingga 1 inci.
summary.en: A larger-bore, low-pressure single-valve coupling for air, water, or oil connections from 1/2 through 1 inch.

summary.id: Socket one-touch untuk penyambungan satu tangan pada jalur udara low-pressure; kompatibel dengan plug CAL Type 20.
summary.en: A one-touch socket for single-handed connection on low-pressure air lines, compatible with CAL Type 20 plugs.

products.name: Multi-Connection Couplings
products.model: CAL2L / CAL5L / CAL2WRL / CAT2L / CAT5L / CAT2WRL

summary.id: Manifold dua atau empat outlet untuk membagi satu suplai udara, tersedia dalam tipe straight dan rotary untuk membantu mencegah hose twisting.
summary.en: Two- or four-outlet manifolds for branching one air supply, with straight and rotary versions that help prevent hose twisting.

summary.id: Quick coupling compact dan ringan untuk pipa 1/8 atau 1/4 inci, dengan one-touch connection dan air leakage rendah.
summary.en: A compact, lightweight coupling for 1/8- or 1/4-inch piping, with one-touch connection and reduced air leakage.

products.name: CTL Type Valveless Couplings
products.model: CTL01 / CTL02 / CTL03 / CTL04 / CTL06 / CTL08 / CTL10 / CTL12 / CTL16

summary.id: Coupling medium-pressure valveless dengan flow resistance rendah untuk udara, air, oli, dan fluida berviskositas tinggi.
summary.en: A valveless, medium-pressure coupling with low flow resistance for air, water, oil, and higher-viscosity fluids.

summary.id: Quick coupling SUS304 twin-valve yang mengurangi tetesan saat disconnection sekitar 99,8% dibanding SPE pada pengujian NAC.
summary.en: A SUS304 twin-valve safety coupling that cuts disconnection drip by approximately 99.8% versus SPE in NAC testing.

products.name: CSPE Type Large-Flow Couplings
products.model: CSPE01 / CSPE02 / CSPE03 / CSPE04 / CSPE06 / CSPE08

summary.id: Coupling twin-valve medium-pressure dengan jalur aliran besar dan halus untuk membantu mengurangi pressure loss dan konsumsi energi.
summary.en: A medium-pressure twin-valve coupling with a large, smooth flow path to reduce pressure loss and energy consumption.

products.name: CSP Type Twin-Valve Couplings
products.model: CSP01 / CSP02 / CSP03 / CSP04 / CSP06 / CSP08 / CSP10 / CSP12 / CSP16

summary.id: Quick coupling medium-pressure dengan automatic shut-off valve di socket dan plug untuk membantu menahan fluida pada kedua sisi.
summary.en: A medium-pressure coupling with automatic shut-off valves in both socket and plug to retain fluid on both sides.

summary.id: Versi vacuum twin-valve untuk jalur air-conditioner dan vacuum service, dengan performa vacuum hingga 1,3 × 10⁻¹ Pa.
summary.en: A twin-valve vacuum version for air-conditioning and vacuum service, with vacuum performance to 1.3 × 10⁻¹ Pa.

products.name: CHP Type High-Pressure Couplings
products.model: CHP02 / CHP03 / CHP04 / CHP06 / CHP08 / CHP10 / CHP12 / CHP16

summary.id: Coupling twin-valve untuk hydraulic equipment dan jalur high-pressure hingga normal working pressure 20,5 MPa.
summary.en: A twin-valve coupling for hydraulic equipment and high-pressure lines with working pressure up to 20.5 MPa.

summary.id: High-pressure coupling SUS304/FKM dengan double-sleeve lock untuk membantu menahan vibrasi, impact, dan pelepasan tidak disengaja.
summary.en: A SUS304/FKM high-pressure coupling with a double-sleeve lock to resist vibration, impact, and unintended release.

summary.id: Coupling brass untuk sirkuit cooling-water mold dengan sleeve panjang agar pemasangan dan penggantian mold lebih mudah.
summary.en: A brass coupling for mold cooling-water circuits with an extended sleeve for easier connection and mold replacement.

summary.id: Cover socket dan plug untuk membantu mencegah debu masuk, melindungi sealing surface, dan memperpanjang masa pakai coupling.
summary.en: Socket and plug covers that help exclude dust, protect sealing surfaces, and extend coupling service life.

products.name: CCH Type Coil Tubes with Couplings

summary.id: Polyurethane coil tube ringan dan fleksibel dengan opsi CAL20 atau CAT coupling untuk jalur udara workshop.
summary.en: Lightweight, flexible polyurethane coil tube supplied with CAL20 or CAT coupling options for workshop air lines.

summary.id: Coupling custom untuk geometri, material, sealing, automatic actuation, vacuum, atau pressure duty yang tidak dapat dipenuhi produk standar.
summary.en: Custom couplings for geometry, materials, sealing, automatic actuation, vacuum, or pressure duties beyond standard products.
